summary: Actual Budget — a self-hosted, local-first personal finance app. Two layers: loot-core (a SQLite budget engine with accounts, payees, categories, transactions, schedules, rules, notes, preferences, reports, dashboards, tags, filters, budget cells, all behind an RPC method bus) and sync-server (a Node/Postgres sync + multi-user admin backend with users, sessions, files, file access grants, server secrets and prefs). The wire interface is app.method(name, fn) RPC registrations for loot-core and HTTP routes for sync-server.
